# Demo pet media (DEMO_SYNTHETIC)

Deterministically generated Pillow illustrations of the PLI demo pets （豆豆 corgi-like dog / 咪咪 standard cat) at the six capture angles. License: self-authored (MIT, in-repo). They are NOT real photos and must never be presented as real-pet identity validation `REAL_PET_IDENTITY_VALIDATION = NOT_YET_OBSERVED`.
